    df_counted['_is_last'] = ~df_counted.duplicated(subset=['Claim ID', 'Line No'], keep='last')
    df_valid = df_counted[df_counted['_is_last']].copy()

    # Denial rate: denied / (all non-pending claims)
    # Denied = status in denied-like values; pending = status like 'pending'/'in process'
    denied_statuses = {'denied', 'deny', 'rejection', 'rejected', 'not paid'}
    pending_statuses = {'pending', 'in process', 'in progress', 'pended', 'suspended'}

    df_valid['_status_lower'] = df_valid['Claim Status'].astype(str).str.lower().str.strip()
    df_valid['_is_denied'] = df_valid['_status_lower'].isin(denied_statuses)
    df_valid['_is_pending'] = df_valid['_status_lower'].isin(pending_statuses)

    # Non-pending claims only for denial rate denominator
    df_nonpending = df_valid[~df_valid['_is_pending']].copy()

    # Per payer: distinct claim_ids denied / distinct claim_ids (non-pending)
    payer_groups = df_nonpending.groupby('Payer')

    denial_results = []
    for payer, grp in payer_groups:
        total_claims = grp['Claim ID'].nunique()
        denied_claims = grp[grp['_is_denied']]['Claim ID'].nunique()
        rate = denied_claims / total_claims if total_claims > 0 else 0.0
        denial_results.append({"name": str(payer), "value": round(rate, 6)})

    denial_results_sorted = sorted(denial_results, key=lambda x: x['value'], reverse=True)

    # Overall denial rate
    total_all = df_nonpending['Claim ID'].nunique()
    denied_all = df_nonpending[df_nonpending['_is_denied']]['Claim ID'].nunique()
    overall_rate = denied_all / total_all if total_all > 0 else 0.0

    result['segments'] = [
        {
            "segment_column": "Payer",
            "metric_column": "Claim Status",
            "aggregation": "ratio",

            "metric_column": "Claim Status",
            "aggregation": "ratio",
            "label": "denial_rate_overall",
            "results": [{"name": "overall", "value": round(overall_rate, 6)}]
        }
    ]

    result['assumptions'] = [
        "Denial rate = distinct denied claim_ids / distinct non-pending claim_ids (voided and superseded versions excluded).",
        "Denied statuses matched: denied, deny, rejection, rejected, not paid (case-insensitive).",

        "Only 'counted' row_kind rows used; last version per claim_id+line selected.",
        "Claim-level counts used (distinct Claim ID), not row counts."
    ]

except Exception as e:
    result['segments'] = [{"segment_column": "Payer", "metric_column": "Claim Status", "aggregation": "ratio", "label": "denial_rate", "results": [{"name": f"error: {str(e)}", "value": 0.0}]}]

    df_nonpending = df_valid[~df_valid['_is_pending']].copy()

    # Per payer: distinct claim_ids denied / distinct claim_ids (non-pending)
    payer_groups = df_nonpending.groupby('Payer')

    denial_results = []
    for payer, grp in payer_groups:
        total_claims = grp['Claim ID'].nunique()
        denied_claims = grp[grp['_is_denied']]['Claim ID'].nunique()
        rate = denied_claims / total_claims if total_claims > 0 else 0.0
        denial_results.append({"name": str(payer), "value": round(rate, 6)})

    denial_results_sorted = sorted(denial_results, key=lambda x: x['value'], reverse=True)

    # Overall denial rate
    total_all = df_nonpending['Claim ID'].nunique()
    denied_all = df_nonpending[df_nonpending['_is_denied']]['Claim ID'].nunique()
    overall_rate = denied_all / total_all if total_all > 0 else 0.0

    result['segments'] = [
        {
            "segment_column": "Payer",
            "metric_column": "Claim Status",
            "aggregation": "ratio",
            "label": "denial_rate",
            "results": denial_results_sorted
        },
        {
            "segment_column": "Payer",
            "metric_column": "Claim Status",
            "aggregation": "ratio",
            "label": "denial_rate_overall",
            "results": [{"name": "overall", "value": round(overall_rate, 6)}]
        }
    ]

    result['assumptions'] = [
        "Denial rate = distinct denied claim_ids / distinct non-pending claim_ids (voided and superseded versions excluded).",
        "Denied statuses matched: denied, deny, rejection, rejected, not paid (case-insensitive).",
        "Pending statuses excluded from denominator: pending, in process, in progress, pended, suspended.",
        "Only 'counted' row_kind rows used; last version per claim_id+line selected.",
        "Claim-level counts used (distinct Claim ID), not row counts."
    ]

except Exception as e:
    result['segments'] = [{"segment_column": "Payer", "metric_column": "Claim Status", "aggregation": "ratio", "label": "denial_rate", "results": [{"name": f"error: {str(e)}", "value": 0.0}]}]
